input.name: image
input.encoding: grayscale, dark text on light paper, ink = 1 - pixel/255; text line scaled to 75% of the height and centered, long lines cut into overlapping 256-px windows (see predict_onnx.py)

fine_info.mincho_old: オールドスタイル明朝: small delicate counters, small kana, lingering brush strokes, organic curves.
fine_info.mincho_modern: モダン明朝: larger, dynamic counters; simpler, clean strokes; sometimes low contrast.
fine_info.gothic_old: オールドスタイルゴシック: old-style proportions in a sans (small kana and counters).
fine_info.gothic_humanist: モダンゴシック (humanist): modern strokes, traditional letterforms.
fine_info.gothic_geometric: モダンゴシック (systematic): prominently larger counters and kana, systematic strokes.
fine_info.batang_old: Old-style Korean serif: small counters, brush-like lingering strokes, geometric Hunminjeongeum letterform.
fine_info.batang_modern: Modern Korean serif: humanist or stiff text serif, larger letter size (Noto Serif KR, Nanum Myeongjo).

usage: Average each output over the windows of a line. coarse = argmax(coarse). Use the fine output whose (lang, coarse) matches argmax(script) (or the known language) and the coarse class; if none matches there is no fine class.
